raw_segments.text: Yeigo, stand you a while apart, confine yourself but in a patient list. Whilst you were here
or whelmed with your grief, a passion most unsuiting such a man, Cassio, came hither.
I shifted him away, and laid good skews upon your ecstasy, bade him a non-return, and here
speak with me, the which he promised. Do but encave yourself, and mark the fleers, the jibes,
and notable scorns that dwell in every region of his face, for I will make him tell the
tale anew, where, how, how oft, how long ago, and when he hath, and is again to cope
your wife, I say but mark his gesture. Marry, patience, or I shall say you are all in all
in spleen, and nothing of a man.
